description.value: Poke Time serves poke bowls in downtown Vancouver with both indoor and outdoor seating, catering to dietary diversity with vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options. This fast-casual format makes it convenient for cyclists needing a quick, nutritious stop.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 47m; stands (2 spaces) at 51m; stands (12 spaces) at 68m; stands (8 spaces) at 85m; stands (8 spaces) at 98m. Total: 34 spaces.
